briefing: Markets were flat today with NASDAQ -0.1% and S&P 500 -0.3%, giving no clear risk-on or risk-off signal. Since cash ($689.29) is above the $500 threshold and 3 slots remain open, we deployed modestly into QLYS on strong technicals rather than sit fully idle, but kept conviction medium due to the absence of a volume-surge confirmation. All seven existing positions are held unchanged through this neutral session.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Not all bullish signals carry equal weight — the strongest buy setups combine multiple confirming indicators (like RSI, MACD, price vs moving average, AND volume) rather than just one or two. When a stock shows good technicals but lacks volume confirmation, it's often wiser to size the position smaller (medium instead of high conviction) rather than skip it entirely or go all-in.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 並非所有利好訊號的份量都一樣——最強的買入時機通常同時具備多個確認指標(例如RSI、MACD、股價相對均線位置,以及成交量),而非單靠一兩個訊號。當個股技術面良好但缺乏成交量確認時,較穩妥的做法是縮小注碼(採中等信心而非高信心),而非完全放棄或重倉買入。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no dominant catalyst, reflecting a session of consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. Trading volumes and price moves were muted across both the NASDAQ and S&P 500. Without a strong macro trigger, investors appeared to be digesting recent gains rather than chasing new positions.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅整理,納指及標普500分別微跌0.1%及0.3%,未見明顯主導消息刺激市場方向。成交量及波幅均偏溫和,反映投資者傾向消化近期升幅,而非積極追入新倉。整體市況呈中性格局。

trades.reasoning: Top-scoring candidate (95) with RSI in bullish zone, MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, and price above SMA-20, but sized medium since no volume surge confirms institutional participation.
